# Target schema columns and their types for reference:
# ['anime_id': int, 'name': str, 'genre': str, 'type': str, 'episodes': int, 'rating': float, 'members': int]

# Read all source files into a list of DataFrames
dfs = []
for file_path in source_files:
    df = pd.read_csv(file_path, index_col=0)
    # Ensure columns are exactly as target schema and in the correct order
    # All source schemas are identical and match target columns by name and type
    # Just reorder columns to target schema order to be safe
    df = df[['anime_id', 'name', 'genre', 'type', 'episodes', 'rating', 'members']]
    # Convert columns to target types explicitly to ensure consistency
    df['anime_id'] = df['anime_id'].astype(int)
    df['name'] = df['name'].astype(str)
    df['genre'] = df['genre'].astype(str)
    df['type'] = df['type'].astype(str)
    df['episodes'] = df['episodes'].astype(int)
    df['rating'] = df['rating'].astype(float)
    df['members'] = df['members'].astype(int)
    dfs.append(df)

# UNION operation: concatenate all DataFrames vertically
target_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

# Write the result to the specified target path
target_df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_75/target_multisource.csv", index=False)
